question: Approve the ideation design — one-file chat rooms via a new channel-independent prepared-room predicate, provider opt-in minting today's exact bytes, and the mediaType/item-type drops CUT because q0's preflight requires both?

artifacts.summary: Spike inverted the seed: request-digest != '' is the predicate eight code sites use for 'this attempt has a prepared room', so dropping the file naively drops four guards (replay, rebind, retained-authority, withdraw — measured: gate withdraw exits 1 on a chat room today; io.go:204 skips retained-authority for request-less bindings). Design adds preparedRoomBinding as the channel-independent predicate at six sites, moves the withdraw guard to the verb that can stat the room, and extends retained-authority validation to chat rooms — the new default is MORE checked than today's, not less. Provider opt-in proven byte-identical to baseline at fixture commits; q0's actual Prepare (75ef1a2) accepts the opt-in room and refuses the chat room by name. Both seeded field drops are CUT, not deferred: q0's preflight refuses manifests without item type or mediaType (proven by exercise with passing controls). status --validate byte-identical over the real 600-room checkout. Estimate net +200 across 14 files, tolerance ±60/±3 (production +62, measured from the spike diff). internal/gates high-stakes: detached audit in the test plan. Four doc diffs included.
